text:
diane.marketing: Draft landed: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft-new. Asks: pick a hero, put a one-line benchmark callout under hero, finalize webinar CTA + 3 reg tiers, add UTMs + hidden lead tag. Quick passes by 3pm PT pls.

paul.prod: Skimmed. Hero suggestion: 'Redwood Inference — predictable, production LLM serving that can reduce per-token inference cost by up to ~40% on common batch/latency profiles.'

anya.content: Agree move the stat up. Proposed callout under hero: "Benchmark snapshot: up to ~40% lower per-token cost vs baseline single-instance serving*" then footnote. Shorten intro para to 2 lines.

diane.marketing: Drafted hero + callout in doc. Footnote placeholder: "*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results may vary. See appendix for methodology and dates." Rene, quick legal pass?

rene.legal: Quickpass: OK with "can reduce" and "up to". Use that footnote text but expand: "results vary by model, sequence length, batch size, and config." Add privacy note by form: "By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; contact data is stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy." No competitor names without public citation.

mason.growth: UTMs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2`. Add hidden field `launch_interest`. Reg select: [Attend live, Watch recording, Case-study/pilot]. I'll map fields to HubSpot once content is locked. Also recommend tag `launch_q2` for lead routing.

vio.design: I'll make a compact stat card and CTA. Need final CTA text + 2-line "what you'll learn" for the card. Also propose a small mobile sticky register button.

diane.marketing: CTA proposal: "Register: Live launch walkthrough + cost playbook"
What you'll learn:
- Unit-cost levers and benchmark context
- Deployment checklist for Dedicated & Private
- Live demo + Q&A with product team
Link to lock: `/events/launch?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_q2`
Privacy note included per legal.

scheduler-bot: Reminder: publish window opens in 36 hours. Final approvals required by 3pm PT to hit the slot.

rene.legal: Approved with footnote and privacy note.

paul.prod: Approved. Please include appendix details: model family, sequence lengths, batch sizes, hardware, and Optimize toggles used in the runs.

anya.content: Approved from content side. Tightened a couple lines.

mason.growth: +1 on UTMs, fields, and tag. I'll prepare HubSpot mapping after lock.

diane.marketing: Thanks all :tada: Locking content at 3pm PT if no objections and kicking design + HubSpot handoff.
